Samira (CSM): Hey team — starting Pegasus onboarding thread. Goal: 30-day launch for search-powered recommendations. Quick round: confirm stakeholders + success criteria.

Diego (AE): Intro from Pegasus — Nia is customer PM, Jordan handles security, want SSO + private VPC. Deal signed 3/1.

Nia (Pegasus PM): hi! timeline: pilot in 4 weeks, production in 10 weeks. success = <80ms median latency, 99.9% availability, 10% lift in CTR.

Ravi (Eng Lead): noted. We'll need a model variant that fits latency. Planning infra support for VPC. Can we get sample traffic and schema?

Lila (Success Ops): I'll own onboarding checklist and run weekly status. I'll send templates. Deliverables: entitlement, SSO config, network runbook, test prompts.

Ivy (Solutions Eng): I'll pair with Nia on evals. Proposed 30d plan: week1 integration + auth, week2 data + prompts, week3 evals & perf tuning, week4 pilot rollout.

Jordan (Pegasus Sec): security ask: SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, traffic stays in VPC. Need contact for infra team.

Samira (CSM): Jordan — cc'ing @Ravi for infra contact. Ravi, can you nominate an infra owner?

Ravi (Eng Lead): assigning to @Aisha (Infra). Aisha please confirm network access window (we prefer 2-hour slot for firewall rules).

Aisha (Infra): can do weekdays 9–11am PT. Also need sample IPs and VPN creds.

Lila (Success Ops): Creating tracking doc. Quick wins to measure: latency, token cost, CTR lift, false positive rate. I'll post baseline template.

OnboardBot: calendar invite created: 'Pegasus Onboard Kickoff' 2026-03-25 10:00 PT — joining: Samira, Diego, Nia, Ravi, Ivy, Jordan, Lila, Aisha

Samira (CSM): thanks — action items: 1) Pegasus to share sample dataset + schema by Fri 3/20; 2) Aisha to confirm IPs by Mon; 3) Ivy to provision eval harness. Anyone add?

Diego (AE): I'll follow up with contract deliverables and entitlements.

Nia (Pegasus PM): shared initial dataset link: https://pegasus.example/datasets/seed.csv — has PII masked. I'll add more by Friday.

Lila (Success Ops): added items to tracking doc and assigned owners. Tagging follow-up meeting weekly on Thursdays.

Samira (CSM): perfect. Closing for now — will update thread with kickoff notes after meeting. :rocket:
